title: Henri IV to Savary de Brèves, Constantinople, 1603, BnF fr. 3541 ff. 60-104 (catalogue item 23)

steps.what: Found the office key in BnF fr. 3462 f. 103 (Gallica canvas 109) and transcribed it; checked it against Tomokiyo's partial f. 60 reading.
Located the clear text in Berger de Xivrey, Lettres missives VI: three letters in full, nine in summary; corrected Tomokiyo's f. 60 overlay.
Searched Gallica SRU, the BnF notice and Desenclos 2018 for images of fr. 3541.
BnF catalogue search found fr. 4029, a clear register copy of all twelve 1603 letters, not digitised.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): Berger de Xivrey's 1853 printed texts of the three full letters (berger/*.txt) and his summaries of the other nine (berger/table_pp667-682.txt); key.md (the office key, fr. 3462 f. 103). No transcription (fr. 3541 not digitised); nine letters only as summaries.

outcome.method_basis: The clear text comes from Berger de Xivrey, Lettres missives VI (1853), printed from a contemporary clear copy (3 letters in full, 9 in summary); the office key was located in BnF fr. 3462 f. 103 and checked against Tomokiyo's partial reading of f. 60, but the fr. 3541 ciphertext is not online and was never deciphered here.
outcome.notes: Not deciphered here: the ciphertext of fr. 3541 is not online. Clear text exists in print (3 full, 9 summaries) and in fr. 4029.

texts.label: Paris, 18 Feb 1603 (fr. 3541 f. 60)
texts.summary: Henri IV to François Savary de Brèves, his ambassador at the Porte (1591-1605): among other matters, Leopold's coadjutorship obtained by the Cardinal of Lorraine without the King's knowledge, and the arms of protestants and catholics 'jà prestes d'une part et d'aultre'. Text: Berger de Xivrey, Lettres missives VI (1853) pp. 31-32, printed from a contemporary clear copy (Monmerqué's 'Lettres à l'ambassadeur du Levant'); Tomokiyo's partial overlay reading of f. 60 is corrected against it in NOTES.md.
texts.note: No transcription: fr. 3541 is not digitised (project work once a reproduction is obtained).

texts.label: Metz, 31 Mar 1603 (f. 63)
texts.summary: Henri IV to Brèves, written at Metz 'le dernier jour de mars' (not 1 March as usually cited); full text in Berger de Xivrey, Lettres missives VI (1853) pp. 63-65, from the clear copy.
texts.note: No transcription: fr. 3541 is not digitised.

texts.label: Fontainebleau, 17 Apr 1603 (f. 66)
texts.summary: Henri IV to Brèves from Fontainebleau; full text in Berger de Xivrey, Lettres missives VI (1853) pp. 76-78, with the cipher passages in italics.
texts.note: No transcription: fr. 3541 is not digitised.

texts.label: Nine further letters, 1 May - 23/24 Dec 1603 (ff. 69-104)
texts.summary: The nine other ciphered letters of 1603 from Henri IV to Brèves, known only from Berger de Xivrey's summaries (Lettres missives VI, pp. 667-682, Wikisource OCR).
texts.note: Summaries only, not full decryptions. The full clear text is in BnF fr. 4029 ff. 118-128 (register of Henri IV's letters to Brèves), not digitised; no transcription, fr. 3541 is not digitised (project work: reproductions of fr. 4029 and fr. 3541).

prior.where: Berger de Xivrey 1853 (from a contemporary clear copy); BnF fr. 4029 clear register copy; Tomokiyo's partial reading of f. 60
